## Diamonds, Soccer, & Decadence: Decoding European Business

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="30%"}

Are you interested in learning about European business and culture while traveling abroad? This summer (2027), Augsburg University is offering a unique study abroad opportunity to Belgium and the Netherlands. Students will explore the history, culture, and business practices of multiple vibrant cities while earning academic credit.
:::
:::
::::
